007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Conversation;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.ConversationAttributes;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIOptions;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.RunTeamRequest;
016import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.TeamExecutionState;
017import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.TeamRunResult;
018import oracle.ucp.UniversalConnectionPoolAdapter;
019import oracle.ucp.admin.UniversalConnectionPoolManager;
020import oracle.ucp.admin.UniversalConnectionPoolManagerImpl;
021import oracle.ucp.jdbc.PoolDataSource;
022import oracle.ucp.jdbc.PoolDataSourceFactory;
023
024import javax.sql.DataSource;
025import java.sql.SQLException;
026import java.util.UUID;
027
028/**
029 * Starts and resumes a human-input workflow in separate processes using UCP.
030 *
031 * <p>Use an existing team whose task enables the human tool and asks for
032 * missing information or approval. The first prompt must cause the workflow
033 * to pause: this sample verifies {@code WAITING_FOR_HUMAN}, rather than
034 * treating a second ordinary conversation turn as a resume. It does not
035 * create or change the team's definition, profile, or tools.</p>
036 *
037 * <p>Run {@code start}, preserve its printed conversation ID, then run
038 * {@code resume} with that ID and the human's response. Each invocation owns
039 * and destroys its own Oracle UCP pool, so resume cannot reuse the first
040 * process's database session. Each SDK operation borrows and returns a
041 * connection. No connection is held while the application waits for a person
042 * between invocations.</p>
043 *
044 * <p>Required for both commands: {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER},
045 * {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD}, {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}, and
046 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_NAME} (optionally owner-qualified). For
047 * {@code start}, also set {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_PROMPT}. For
048 * {@code resume}, set {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_CONVERSATION_ID} and
049 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_HUMAN_RESPONSE}. The same database identity and team
050 * must be used for both commands. Optional {@code SELECTAI_QUERY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}
051 * configures the SDK statement timeout; a timeout does not guarantee that
052 * database or provider work stopped. Failed calls are never retried here.</p>
053 *
054 * <p>The conversation is deliberately retained, including on failure, for
055 * later resume or inspection. After the workflow is finished and no longer
056 * needed, set {@code SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID} to the same ID and run
057 * {@link com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.conversation.DropConversationSample}.
058 * Do not drop a conversation while its workflow is running. In production,
059 * store the team name and conversation ID in authorized application state,
060 * and serialize human responses for the same workflow.</p>
061 *
062 * <p>Build the SDK and copy dependencies with the {@code samples} Maven
063 * profile, which includes UCP. After compiling the samples, run:</p>
064 * <pre>{@code
065 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.1.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
066 *     com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent.PooledTeamResumeSample start
067 * // Set SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_CONVERSATION_ID to the printed ID and
068 * // SELECTAI_AGENT_HUMAN_RESPONSE to the human's answer, then:
069 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.1.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
070 *     com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent.PooledTeamResumeSample resume
071 * }</pre>
072 *
073 * @see SelectAIAgent#runTeam(String, RunTeamRequest)
074 * @see SelectAIAgent#getTeamStateByConversationId(String, String)
075 */
076public final class PooledTeamResumeSample {
077    private PooledTeamResumeSample() {
078    }
079
080    /**
081     * Runs one application request and closes its application-owned pool.
082     *
083     * @param args exactly one command: {@code start} or {@code resume}
084     * @throws Exception when configuration, execution, or pool cleanup fails
085     */
086    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
087        if (args.length != 1 || !("start".equals(args[0]) || "resume".equals(args[0]))) {
088            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Usage: PooledTeamResumeSample start|resume");
089        }
090        boolean starting = "start".equals(args[0]);
091        String teamName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_NAME");
092        String input = requiredEnv(starting
093                ? "SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_PROMPT" : "SELECTAI_AGENT_HUMAN_RESPONSE");
094        String conversationId = starting ? null : requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_CONVERSATION_ID");
095        String timeout = System.getenv("SELECTAI_QUERY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS");
096        SelectAIOptions options = SelectAIOptions.builder()
097                .queryTimeoutSeconds(timeout == null || timeout.isBlank() ? null : Integer.valueOf(timeout))
098                .build();
099
100        PoolDataSource pool = createPool();
101        UniversalConnectionPoolManager manager = UniversalConnectionPoolManagerImpl
102                .getUniversalConnectionPoolManager();
103        manager.createConnectionPool((UniversalConnectionPoolAdapter) pool);
104        // The SDK closes borrowed connections, but the application owns the pool.
105        try (AutoCloseable cleanup = () -> manager.destroyConnectionPool(pool.getConnectionPoolName())) {
106            manager.startConnectionPool(pool.getConnectionPoolName());
107            if (starting) {
108                start(pool, options, teamName, input);
109            } else {
110                resume(pool, options, teamName, conversationId, input);
111            }
112        }
113    }
114
115    /** Creates a conversation and verifies that the first run really pauses. */
116    static String start(DataSource dataSource, SelectAIOptions options, String teamName,
117                        String prompt) throws SelectAIException {
118        try (SelectAI selectAI = SelectAI.create(dataSource, options);
119             SelectAIAgent agentClient = SelectAIAgent.create(dataSource, options)) {
120            Conversation conversation = selectAI.conversation(ConversationAttributes.builder()
121                    .title("Pooled human-input workflow")
122                    .build());
123            String conversationId = conversation.create();
124            // Print before RUN_TEAM so a failed call still leaves a recovery ID.
125            System.out.println("Conversation ID: " + conversationId);
126            TeamRunResult result = agentClient.runTeam(teamName, RunTeamRequest.builder()
127                    .userPrompt(prompt)
128                    .conversationId(conversationId)
129                    .build());
130            System.out.println("Team response: " + (result == null ? "<no response>" : result.getRawValue()));
131            requireWaiting(agentClient, teamName, conversationId);
132            System.out.println("State: WAITING_FOR_HUMAN. Preserve the ID and run resume with the human response.");
133            return conversationId;
134        }
135    }
136
137    /** Resumes only a waiting run, using the ID from a previous application request. */
138    static TeamExecutionState resume(DataSource dataSource, SelectAIOptions options, String teamName,
139                                     String conversationId, String humanResponse) throws SelectAIException {
140        try (SelectAIAgent agentClient = SelectAIAgent.create(dataSource, options)) {
141            requireWaiting(agentClient, teamName, conversationId);
142            TeamRunResult result = agentClient.runTeam(teamName, RunTeamRequest.builder()
143                    .userPrompt(humanResponse)
144                    .conversationId(conversationId)
145                    .build());
146            System.out.println("Resumed team response: " + (result == null ? "<no response>" : result.getRawValue()));
147            TeamExecutionState state = agentClient.getTeamStateByConversationId(teamName, conversationId);
148            System.out.println("State after resume: " + state);
149            if (state != TeamExecutionState.SUCCEEDED && state != TeamExecutionState.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN) {
150                throw new IllegalStateException("Unexpected state after resume: " + state
151                        + ". Inspect the retained conversation; do not automatically retry RUN_TEAM.");
152            }
153            if (state == TeamExecutionState.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN) {
154                System.out.println("More human input is required. Preserve the same conversation ID.");
155            }
156            return state;
157        }
158    }
159
160    private static void requireWaiting(SelectAIAgent client, String teamName, String conversationId)
161            throws SelectAIException {
162        TeamExecutionState state = client.getTeamStateByConversationId(teamName, conversationId);
163        if (state != TeamExecutionState.WAITING_FOR_HUMAN) {
164            throw new IllegalStateException("Expected WAITING_FOR_HUMAN but found " + state
165                    + ". This sample requires a workflow paused for human input.");
166        }
167    }
168
169    private static PoolDataSource createPool() throws SQLException {
170        PoolDataSource pool = PoolDataSourceFactory.getPoolDataSource();
171        pool.setConnectionPoolName("PooledTeamResumeSample-" + UUID.randomUUID());
172        pool.setConnectionFactoryClassName("oracle.jdbc.pool.OracleDataSource");
173        pool.setURL(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"));
174        pool.setUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"));
175        pool.setPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"));
176        pool.setInitialPoolSize(0);
177        pool.setMinPoolSize(0);
178        pool.setMaxPoolSize(2);
179        pool.setConnectionWaitTimeout(10);
180        return pool;
181    }
182
183    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
184        String value = System.getenv(name);
185        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
186            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
187        }
188        return value;
189    }
190}
